A Purpose The purpose of this article is to provide for the land use, development and conservation of lakeshore areas of Buckeye Lake within Licking Township, and to preserve and protect the, scenic and aesthetic values and lake water quality. Buckeye Lake is a natural living organism. All development along its shoreline should be critically reviewed to assess the detriment that it will cause by its allowance. Further, the purpose of the Buckeye Lake Area Business (BLB) District is to provide for mixed use areas where both residential and commercial business can exist in a compatible manner. It is intended that commercial business serving the local business uses commonly associated with lakeshore areas be located in these zones. S
